Hi all — attaching the initial evidence bundle for Kepler. Highlights below and attachments at the bottom.

1) Redwood SOC 2 Type II (audit period): 2025-11-01 through 2026-10-31. (redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf)

2) Cloud provider coverage:
   - NimbusCloud SOC 2 Type II (covers compute, storage, and networking used by Redwood) — see nimbus_soc2_2026.pdf.
   - Nimbus has explicitly excluded managed DB backups in their report; we obtained a Nimbus bridge letter to clarify the exclusion and confirm compensating controls (nimbus_bridge_letter_2026.pdf).

3) Subprocessor inventory: subprocessor_inventory_20261115.csv — fields include name, role, region, published_attestation_url, contact.

4) Notable gap: LogRoll Analytics (log aggregation/analytics) does not publish a SOC report. We collected their security questionnaire and retention/pseudonymization excerpts (logroll_qa_response.pdf). We are working with LogRoll on an SSAE attestation timeline; in the interim we apply compensating controls:
   - Encrypted in-flight and at-rest for streamed telemetry;
   - Minimal retention of tenant-level logs by default (30 days) unless customer opts-in;
   - Strict RBAC: only infra ops principals have access; access is logged and reviewed weekly.

5) Shared responsibility summary (short):
   - Redwood: network security, compute/storage hardening, key management for service-level encryption, platform-level access controls, patching of our runtime.
   - Customer: tenant configuration (IAM/API keys), data classification and encryption at application layer, customer-side key rotation if using customer-managed keys.

Next steps: please confirm whether Kepler will accept the Nimbus bridge letter as evidence for the limited exclusion. If Kepler's auditor requires a different form of attestation (eg direct confirmation from Nimbus to Kepler's auditor), we can coordinate an introduction to Erin at ABC Audit (CC'd).

Attachments included in this message:
- redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report)
- nimbus_soc2_2026.pdf (cloud provider SOC)
- nimbus_bridge_letter_2026.pdf (provider bridge letter confirming exclusion and controls)
- subprocessor_inventory_20261115.csv (inventory)
- logroll_qa_response.pdf (LogRoll questionnaire & retention policy excerpt)

If useful I can also share a short system diagram and sample config evidence for the infra controls Erin referenced (diagram + sample runbook).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Thanks for looping me in. I reviewed the attached bundle and have a couple of notes from the auditor perspective:

- The Redwood SOC 2 Type II PDF and Nimbus SOC 2 look consistent with the controls cited. Confirmed audit window: 2025-11-01 through 2026-10-31.
- The Nimbus bridge letter is acceptable as limited evidence for the managed DB backup exclusion, provided it includes the effective dates and a named contact (it does).
- For LogRoll (no SOC): the questionnaire and retention excerpts help, but I'll need to see either (a) a signed attestation from LogRoll (preferred) or (b) a document showing compensating controls with a sample of access logs and one-week review evidence.
- Please also provide a short network/system diagram (one page) showing where logs and backups flow, and a single sample runbook entry used for weekly access reviews. These items speed our validation.

If Redwood can share the diagram and a short sample artifact, I can tentatively mark this as materially covered for Kepler's intake, pending the LogRoll follow-up. If you prefer, schedule a 30–45 minute call so we can walk through the artifacts; Calendly link attached.
